description: This is a PHP source file for the entry point of the OrangeHRM web application, responsible for initializing the application, handling the incoming HTTP request, and routing to the appropriate response or redirect.

classes.name: Framework
classes.description: Core application class responsible for handling HTTP requests and responses within the OrangeHRM framework.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, providing methods to access request data and details.

classes.name: RedirectResponse
classes.description: Represents an HTTP redirect response, directing the client to a different URL.

methods.name: Request::createFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a Request object based on global PHP variables ($_GET, $_POST, etc.).

methods.name: Response::send
methods.description: Sends the HTTP response headers and content to the client.
